selection: First published seed of the published modular architecture, selected before evaluating this task.
task: Given two occurrences of one carrier differing in exactly one of vowel, shadda, tanwin or right boundary, predict whether the ordered realized units, including ancestry, differ.
labels: Compare expected_units in the frozen source dataset; never use them or the three old output heads as input to the new head.
pairs: Enumerate each unordered pair exactly once. Retain original carrier partitions. Mark composition if either endpoint has shadda and tanwin; train only on train carriers without composition at either endpoint.
features: Absolute differences of the two frozen modular hidden activations (8 + 24).
controls: same classifier on fixed original random modular features, seed 17
exact comparison of the old three predicted heads for one shared carrier
metrics: raw correct/total per original split and changed field
independent functional pair types per split
old head and ancestry replay on 1008 rows
all nine original checkpoints against archived predictions
acceptance: Preserve all original predictions. Report novel task outcomes for every split and control including ties or losses. Handled candidates have no lexical or licensing authority.
